sanskrit_verse:
त्वं तुले सत्यधामासि पुरा देवैर्विनिर्मिता ।
तत् सत्यं वद कल्याणि संशयान् मां विमोचय ॥१०१॥
transliteration: tvaṃ tule satyadhāmāsi purā devair vinirmitā / tat satyaṃ vada kalyāṇi saṃśayān māṃ vimocaya // YajñS_2.101
sph_interpretive_translation: Thou art the scale established by the Gods of old, abiding in Truth itself; speak that Truth clearly, O Auspicious One, and liberate Me from all doubt.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from divine establishment, not human convention
Truth is a foundational capacity for dharma-adjudication
Responsibility arises through invocation of higher ontological order
Restoration occurs when consciousness aligns with pre-established divine structures
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent invokes truth-bearing instrument THEN truth disclosure obligation activates
IF doubt exists in adjudication THEN refer to divinely-established measuring principle
IF testimony diverges from satyadhāma THEN realign via source-referencing protocol
IF judgment lacks clarity THEN invoke purification process until alignment with deva-vinirmita framework achieved
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court deliberations involving contested factual claims or conflicting testimonies, reference must be made to the primordial measuring standard — tule satyadhāmāsi — as an authoritative benchmark established beyond temporal jurisdiction. Responsibility lies not in assigning blame but in restoring alignment with this eternal scale.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa here is the deva-established scale of truth (satyadhāma), which functions independently of personal intent. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as sequential alignment: invocation → clarification → resolution. There is no punitive element; error or confusion is resolved through reconnection to the original divine calibration, ensuring proportional restoration without infliction.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Invoke satyadhāma resonance test to recalibrate testimonial integrity
Engage śuddhi-kriyā to remove obstructive saṃśaya from involved parties
Establish śānti-vyavasthā between disputants using deva-vinirmita reference point
Execute sākṣātkāra process to restore direct cognition of the truthful balance
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this verse affirms Truth as the ultimate measure, installed by the Gods, immutable and restorative. Doubt dissolves upon alignment with it. Dharma is restored. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
